Resolves #19375

🌿 The other half of the multi-window size contract now has a witness on real chrome: a popped-out pane comes up with the OUTER frame of the slot it left, and the moment that stops being true is the moment a window starts covering its neighbour.

One e2e arm in `WorkstationNativeTitlebarDragNL.spec.mjs`, in its own describe on the real display (`viewport: null`): the centre node's active pane is popped out through the real header action, and the popup's outer frame — OS `outerWidth/outerHeight` and `manager.Window`'s `outerRect` — must equal the tabs node's bounding box read in the main window before the click, within 1 px. The shared helper `workstationPopOut.mjs` now returns that `nodeRect` and the pane's `bodyRect` beside the popup, so no spec re-measures them. Building the arm corrected one fact on the ticket: the engine sizes the vessel to the tabs node (header strip + body), not the pane body; the receipt records both.

Evidence: L3 (local real-chrome NL run, Brain-gated set: the arm passes; one mutation red on the size line; the helper's three consumers 8/8) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2). AC-4's skip guards are exercised by reading, not by a chrome-less run (none is producible on this platform). No residual.

agent-preflight: not run; this consumer's baseline jobs run in CI. The Brain-gated NL e2e set is excluded from CI (`NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` unset there), so the receipt below is the evidence.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | Outside-CI: node `{425×635}` read before the click; popup outer OS `{425×635}`, manager `{425×635}`; body alone `{425×599}` (36 px header strip); chrome `{side: 0, top: 67}`. Receipt below. |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI: `Main#windowOpen`'s `resizeTo` under `useTotalHeight` removed → red on the size line: outer `{425×701}` vs node `635`, one chrome taller. Clean run green after the revert. |
| AC-3 | The helper returns `nodeRect` + `bodyRect`; the arm destructures them, measures nothing itself. |
| AC-4 | Two `test.skip` guards with their reasons: node below the 320×240 floor (fired on the 220- and 284-px side columns while choosing the pane), and chrome 0 (frame == content, a size witness cannot see the class). |

## Deltas from ticket
- "Tab body" → the tabs node's footprint: the engine measures the tab container (`HeaderActions#measureDockPaneRect`) and corrects the OUTER frame to it; the ticket body carries the correction with the measured numbers.
- The arm lives in its own describe with `viewport: null`: under Playwright's emulated viewport a popup's outer size is not the drawn frame, and the default viewport leaves every candidate pane below the vessel floor.
